name: Grilled Zucchini & Veggie Wraps with Garlic Hummus

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ lemons
3 tomatoes
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place in a large bowl.
Peel and thinly slice onions into rings; add to the bowl with the zucchini. Add oil and salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the veggies (working in batches if necessary) and cook until tender, 3-4 minutes per side. Return veggies to the bowl and cover with foil.
Meanwhile, peel garlic and transfer to a blender.
Juice lemons into the blender. Add water, oil, tahini, paprika, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup water
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp tahini
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans; add to the blender. Blend on high for several minutes until smooth. Add more water, one tbsp at a time, if needed, to reach desired consistency. (If your blender is on the smaller side, add half of the beans and blend until smooth; then add remaining beans and blend once more.)
Place tortillas on a flat surface and spread evenly with hummus. Divide zucchini, onion, tomato, and lettuce between them; roll tightly to close.

Return grill pan to medium-high heat. Once the grill pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Working in batches if necessary, place wraps on the grill and cook, rotating every 1-2 minutes, until tortillas are crispy and golden. Cut each wrap in half.
To serve, divide wraps between plates and enjoy!
